source.description: Monero classic (25-word) seed vectors: mnemonic -> spend key, with the view key Monero derives as H(spend).
source.origin: monero-seed's test suite (rust/monero-utils-mirror/seed/src/tests.rs), which carries them from Monero itself.
source.note: Extracted so they exercise monero-rust's seed_compat, the seed implementation the app actually ships. monero-seed itself is not reachable from the app.
source.ambiguity_note: Two Spanish vectors are trim-identical to English ones. monero-seed resolves them because its API takes an explicit language; seed_compat detects the language, so it resolves them the way monero's find_seed_language does. Those carry an 'ambiguous' block with the expected outcome.
